name: How long does a duplex renovation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a duplex renovation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a duplex renovation depends on its complexity and scale. Minor renovations, such as cosmetic updates to a single unit, might take 4-8 weeks. More extensive remodels involving multiple units, structural changes, or significant plumbing and electrical work can take 3-6 months or even longer. Permitting processes, material lead times, and unforeseen issues encountered during demolition can also influence the timeline. We establish a clear project schedule and communicate progress regularly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Duplex renovation timelines range from 4-8 weeks for minor updates to 3-6 months or more for extensive remodels, influenced by scope, permits, and material availability.
